function.name: read_file
function.description: Read the contents of a file

file_path.description: Path to the file to read

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does.

file_path.description: Path to the file to write

content.description: Content to write to the file

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace specific text in a file. Supports line-range targeting and first-only replacement.

file_path.description: Path to the file to edit

old_text.description: Text to search for (must match exactly)

first_only.description: If true, only replace the first occurrence (default: false, replaces all)

start_line.description: Start line number (1-indexed, inclusive). Restricts edit to a line range.

end_line.description: End line number (1-indexed, inclusive). Restricts edit to a line range.

function.name: create_file
function.description: Create a new file. Fails if the file already exists (use write_file to overwrite).

file_path.description: Path to the file to create
Path to the file to delete

function.name: search_code
function.description: Search for text patterns in the codebase

directory.description: Directory to search in (default: current directory)

function.name: git_status
function.description: Get the current git working tree status

function.name: git_diff
function.description: Show git diff of uncommitted changes

staged.description: If true, show staged changes (default: false)

function.name: git_commit
function.description: Stage all changes and commit with a message

function.name: hashline_edit
function.description: Edit a file using hash-anchored line ranges. Safer than edit_file because it detects if the file was modified since it was last read. Edits are applied from bottom to top. Format: ¶PATH#HASH.

file_path.description: Path to the file to edit

expected_hash.description: Expected content hash (8-char hex from ¶PATH#HASH). Fails if file changed.

edits.description: JSON array of edit operations. Each: {"start_line": int, "end_line": int, "new_content": str, "insert_before": bool, "insert_after": bool}
